99 Nights Camp Schedule

Every survivor has a job. Check the table before night falls!

Job Time Danger
Chop wood Morning Low
Find food Afternoon Medium
Night watch Night High
Never go into the forest alone! Learn more survival skills

items.q: Which tag makes the biggest heading?
items.why: <h1> is the biggest heading. <h6> is the smallest.

items.q: Which tag puts a picture on the page?
items.why: shows a picture. It has no closing tag.

items.q: Which tag starts a bullet list?
items.why: <ul> is a bullet list. <ol> is a numbered list. <li> is one item.

items.q: In CSS, which property changes the colour of the text?
items.why: color: orange; changes the text. background-color changes the background.

items.q: Which symbol starts a class selector in CSS?
items.why: A dot is for classes (.card). A hash is for ids (#top).

opts: The name on the browser tab
items.why: <title> goes in the <head> and shows on the tab.

items.q: Which CSS line puts boxes in a row with flexbox?
items.why: display: flex; on the container makes the children line up in a row.

items.q: Which property adds space INSIDE a box, between the words and the border?
items.why: padding is inside the border. margin is outside.

opts: Styles an element when the mouse is over it
items.why: a:hover { color: orange; } changes the link only while the mouse is on it.

hall.title: Night Camp
hall.desc: A one-page school website: a green header with menu links, a title with a mascot, pictures with captions in a table, an About section and a footer, all styled with style="…".
hall.finalCode:
About Contacts

Night Camp ranger school

We invite you to learn how to survive 99 nights in the forest. We teach fire building, tent making, map reading and night watch. Our classes are taught by professional rangers in small groups of different levels, from first-night beginners to rangers who have lasted all 99 nights.

What we teach

Fire building Tent making Night watch

About us

Night Camp opened on the first night in the forest. Since then we have taught hundreds of survivors how to stay safe until morning. Our rangers know every path, every river and every strange sound in the dark. Come and learn from the people who have seen it all.

Address: 15 Forest Road, Camp City. Tel.: 555-0199. Email: ranger@nightcamp.com
